stops.name: roque Bentayga
stops.detail: The Bentayga rock is a monolithic geological formation of Gran Canaria (Canaries, Spain).

stops.name: caldera volcánica de Tejeda
stops.detail: It is located inside the Tejeda volcanic caldera, in the municipality of the same name, in the approximate center of the island.

stops.name: parque rural del Nublo
stops.detail: The rock is found inside the Nublo rural park.

stops.name: almogarén aborigen
stops.detail: It is, furthermore, an archaeological site, since at its base there is an aboriginal 'almogarén' (place of worship).

stops.name: almogarén del Bentayga
stops.detail: On the eastern side of the base of the rock lies the so-called “almogarén of Bentayga”, a construction that must have been a place of worship for the aborigines.
